We have an honest known weakness (multi_failure). We built a complete bench protocol that can disprove our simulator. Will your engineering team try to break it?

5-seed V2.1 validation results (all pre-registered criteria PASSED)

the_ask_R283.what_we_ask: Run the V2.1 simulator. Compare to your current approach. Try to break V2.1 with your own attack scenarios. Tell us: does the rate-limited + sensor-health-aware control mechanism add value beyond your current capability?
the_ask_R283.what_we_do_NOT_ask: We do not ask you to believe V2.1 works. We do not ask you to buy anything. We do not ask for an NDA to see the simulator. We ask you to TEST it.
